segments.name: CEA vertical farming
segments.description: Designs, constructs and operates indoor CEA vertical farms, and sells their fresh produce to wholesalers and retailers.
segments.evidence: For management purposes, the Group operates in one business unit based on its products and has one reportable segment which is offering of farm solutions and selling fresh produce.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay for vertical farm design, construction, operation and sale; wholesalers and retailers pay for fresh produce.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily derive our revenue from: (i) designing and/or constructing indoor CEA vertical farms; (ii) operating and managing indoor CEA vertical farms; (iii) selling CEA vertical farms; (iv) selling of fresh produce from farms operated; and (v) trading of fresh produce
